name: Index
description: Renderer process entry point. Instantiates App class to bootstrap the entire IDE shell. Also handles a legacy theme-toggle click handler (deprecated — TopBar now handles toggling). Loaded as a script by index.html after DOM ready. This is a single-line bootstrap: new App().

dependencies.usage: Instantiate App class to bootstrap the entire renderer

lifecycle.created_by: index.html — loaded as a script tag after DOM ready; executes new App() immediately
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for the entire renderer process lifetime (window close terminates process)
